name: regression-invalid-json-control-chars
description: AI returns JSON with raw newline characters inside a string literal, which strict JSON.parse rejects. Our sanitiser must repair it before validation, and the verifier then rejects the credit because the quote lacks a concrete retention period.
documentText: The provider does not store personal data beyond what is strictly necessary to operate the Service.
